sources.authorityAssessment: High for current RHS accepted spelling, dwarf classification, morphology, seasonal trajectory, dimensions, hardiness, cultivation and propagation.

sources.authorityAssessment: High for extension horticulture, structured traits, seasonal expression, dimensions and risk guidance.
limitations: The name meaning is a source-reported interpretation without a primary naming source.
The five-to-nine-lobe and 2–5-inch structured leaf fields may include species-level inheritance and are not treated as universal cultivar measurements.
Relative heat-tolerance language is qualified by scorch and temperature-risk statements.
Self-seeding does not preserve cultivar identity; seedlings are not governed as the named cultivar.
Image licences and individual creators require separate media-stream review.

editorialNotes.approvalBoundary: Source objects are accepted for use in this editorial draft; the sidecar and RC remain unapproved for freeze.
editorialNotes.spellingDecision: The Atlas working form is the RHS hyphenated 'Mikawa-yatsubusa'; spaced and title-case institutional forms remain search/display variants.
editorialNotes.synonymPosition: No cultivar synonym is approved from the reviewed institutional source set.
editorialNotes.historyLimit: Commercial Tōkai/Mikawa-region and 1970s discovery claims are excluded pending a primary or authoritative traceable locator.
editorialNotes.continuityRule: Seed-derived offspring do not inherit the named cultivar identity, notwithstanding NC State's self-seeding statement.
editorialNotes.archivalLimit: The Chicago Botanic Garden profile is explicitly archived and no longer updated; it is used with that limitation.
editorialNotes.mediaBoundary: Institutional photographs and profile images are research evidence and media leads only; no rights clearance is implied.
editorialNotes.nextReview: Botanical, nomenclatural and cross-record review is required before G4.
